entities.summary: Lithuanian Catholic Church, a political institution in Lithuania during Soviet Era & the Forest Brothers (1953–1988). Grew from Forest Brothers (Partizanai) and Lithuanian Forest Brothers wage guerrilla resistance against Soviet occupation. Led to the emergence of Catholic Church.
